repos.description: SimpleX - the first messaging network operating without user identifiers of any kind - 100% private by design! iOS, Android and desktop apps 📱!
repos.summary_zh: SimpleX Chat是首个无任何用户标识符的消息平台，100%隐私设计，保护消息内容及元数据（通话对象与时间）。采用SMP协议通过单向匿名队列实现去中心化通信，支持用户自建服务器。具备双棘轮E2EE加密、多层防护、带外密钥交换、群组通话等功能。提供iOS、Android、桌面及CLI跨平台应用，适用于隐私敏感用户防范监控与垃圾信息场景。技术亮点包括便携加密存储和Tor支持。
repos.summary_en: SimpleX is the first messaging network operating without any user identifiers whatsoever, providing 100% privacy by design through protection of both message content and metadata. Built on the SimpleX Messaging Protocol (SMP), it uses unidirectional queues with pairwise anonymous addresses for decentralized, server-relayed communication where anyone can host servers. It features double-ratchet end-to-end encryption augmented with additional layers, out-of-band key exchange via links or QR codes, support for encrypted groups, calls, files, and optional Tor access. Cross-platform apps for iOS, Android, desktop, and terminal CLI enable portable encrypted data storage. Ideal for users prioritizing metadata privacy and spam resistance in secure communications.

repos.summary_zh: Technitium DNS Server 是开源跨平台权威/递归DNS服务器，支持自托管以提升隐私与安全。开箱即用，提供Web控制台，可网络级拦截广告与恶意软件，支持DoT/DoH/DoQ加密协议、集群管理、LDAP/OIDC认证及高性能异步IO。适用于家庭与企业网络，内置缓存、DNSSEC与应用扩展框架，显著提升解析速度与控制力。
repos.summary_en: Technitium DNS Server is an open-source cross-platform authoritative and recursive DNS server for self-hosting with strong privacy and security focus. It works out-of-the-box with a web console, enables network-wide ad/malware blocking, supports DoT/DoH/DoQ encrypted protocols, clustering, LDAP/OIDC auth, and high-performance async I/O. Ideal for home and enterprise networks, featuring advanced caching, DNSSEC, and an apps framework for enhanced control and speed.

repos.description: 既然来了，就留下你的Star吧！Serv00 | CT8 | Hostuno | VPS | 游戏机 | sing-box(reality + hy2 + vmess-argo +tuic5)四合一无交互一键安装脚本(已适配Alpine)，支持纯V6 vps，丰富的分流服务, 可添加anytls,socks5,ss-2022等协议
repos.summary_zh: sing-box多协议代理一键安装脚本，支持VLESS-reality、VMess-ws-tls(Argo)、Hysteria2、Tuic5等协议，适配VPS、Serv00、CT8、Alpine等环境。集成哪吒探针、Argo隧道与订阅管理，提供无交互部署、端口自定义与分流服务，适合快速搭建代理节点与网络加速场景。
repos.summary_en: One-click installation script for sing-box multi-protocol proxy, supporting VLESS-reality, VMess-ws-tls (Argo), Hysteria2, Tuic5. Compatible with VPS, Serv00, CT8, Alpine and more. Integrates Nezha monitoring, Argo tunnels and subscription features for automated deployment, custom ports and traffic routing in proxy and acceleration use cases.

repos.description: Bitwarden-compatible server running on Cloudflare Workers
repos.summary_zh: NodeWarden 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的第三方 Bitwarden 兼容服务端，实现零成本自托管密码管理。支持多用户、附件存储、TOTP 及 Passkey 等核心功能，兼容全平台官方客户端。利用 R2/KV 存储保障数据安全，适合个人及小团队私有化部署，规避企业版订阅费用。
repos.summary_en: NodeWarden is a third-party Bitwarden-compatible server deployed on Cloudflare Workers, enabling zero-cost self-hosted password management. It supports multi-user access, attachments, TOTP, and Passkey features while maintaining full compatibility with official clients across platforms. Leveraging R2/KV storage for data security, it's ideal for individuals and small teams seeking private deployment without enterprise subscription fees.

repos.description: The RethinkDNS resolver that deploys to Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io
repos.summary_zh: Serverless-dns 是一个自托管的无服务器 DNS 解析器，提供类似 Pi-Hole 的内容过滤功能，支持 DNS-over-HTTPS 和 DNS-over-TLS。它可一键部署到 Cloudflare Workers、Deno Deploy、Fastly 和 Fly.io 等边缘平台，利用其免费层即可满足10-20台设备的日常需求。服务器处理延迟仅0-2毫秒，端到端延迟中位数为10-30毫秒，具备全球覆盖能力。
repos.summary_en: Serverless-dns is a self-hosted, serverless DNS resolver with Pi-Hole-like content blocking, supporting DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) and DNS-over-TLS (DoT). It deploys effortlessly to edge platforms including Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io. The free tiers suffice for 10-20 devices monthly. Server processing takes 0-2ms, with end-to-end latency of 10-30ms (median), enabling global low-latency DNS resolution.

repos.description: 零知识证明入门教程。Comprehensive Zero-Knowledge Proofs Tutorial. #zk #WIP
repos.summary_zh: WTF-zk 为零知识证明入门教程，面向高中数学基础学习者。项目以 Python 实现核心算法，系统涵盖数论、抽象代数、椭圆曲线等数学基础，并逐步深入 ZK 证明理论。通过 Jupyter Notebook 交互式教学，结合经典密码学方案复现，为零知识证明领域提供低门槛、理论与实践结合的学习路径。
repos.summary_en: WTF-zk is a comprehensive Zero-Knowledge Proofs tutorial designed for learners with only high school mathematics background. The project uses Python to implement core cryptographic algorithms, systematically covering essential mathematical foundations including number theory, abstract algebra, ring fields, and elliptic curves. Through interactive Jupyter Notebook demonstrations and step-by-step reproduction of classic schemes like RSA and Diffie-Hellman, it creates an accessible, theory-practice integrated learning pathway into the ZK proofs domain.

repos.description: A taxonomy for open source cryptocurrency, blockchain, and decentralized ecosystems
repos.summary_zh: Electric Capital 推出的 Open Dev Data 是一个结构化的区块链与 Web3 开源生态分类法。它提供 CLI 工具链，支持按时间快照导出 JSONL 格式的仓库数据，并集成 DuckDB 实现本地高性能分析。通过交互式 SQL 界面，开发者可快速洞察比特币、以太坊等生态的子系统分布与项目演进，为生态研究提供精准数据基础。
repos.summary_en: Open Dev Data by Electric Capital is a structured taxonomy for blockchain and Web3 open-source ecosystems. It offers a CLI toolkit to export repository data in JSONL format with historical snapshots, integrates DuckDB for local high-performance analytics, and provides an interactive SQL interface. Developers can quickly analyze subsystem distributions and project evolution across ecosystems like Bitcoin and Ethereum, enabling precise ecosystem research.

repos.description: 🔒True end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) chat system in web. 🔒真正的网页端到端加密聊天系统
repos.summary_zh: NodeCrypt 是一个基于 Web 的真正端到端加密聊天系统，采用零知识架构确保服务器无法获取明文消息。系统使用三层安全体系：RSA-2048 身份验证、ECDH-P384 密钥协商和混合对称加密（AES-256 + ChaCha20）。基于 Cloudflare Workers 部署，无需数据库，支持匿名聊天和前向安全性，所有加密在客户端完成。
repos.summary_en: NodeCrypt is a true end-to-end encrypted web chat system implementing zero-knowledge architecture where servers cannot access plaintext messages. It employs a three-layer security model: RSA-2048 for server authentication, ECDH-P384 for key negotiation, and hybrid symmetric encryption (AES-256-CBC for control messages, ChaCha20 for chat content). Built on Cloudflare Workers with Durable Objects and WebSocket, the system requires no database storage, supports anonymous communication, and provides forward secrecy. All encryption occurs client-side using Web Cryptography API, with room passwords as key derivation factors. The open-source implementation is verifiable through browser developer tools and network traffic analysis.

repos.description: Reality协议目标网站检测工具 - 一键检测网站是否适合作为Reality协议目标，支持TLS检测、地理位置分析、CDN识别等功能
repos.summary_zh: RealityChecker是专为V2Ray Reality协议设计的目标域名检测工具。通过多维度扫描（TLS 1.3/X25519支持、证书有效性、SNI匹配、CDN识别、地理位置及被墙检测），快速筛选出适合作为Reality目标的优质域名。支持批量检测与智能报告，有效规避热门网站和CDN风险，是搭建稳定代理服务的必备工具。
repos.summary_en: RealityChecker is a specialized domain validation tool designed exclusively for V2Ray Reality protocol. It performs comprehensive multi-dimensional scans including TLS 1.3/X25519 support verification, certificate validity and SNI matching checks, CDN detection, geolocation analysis, and GFW blocking status assessment. The tool enables batch processing of domains and generates intelligent reports to identify optimal Reality targets while filtering out high-risk candidates such as popular websites and CDN-hosted domains. With its ability to detect subtle technical characteristics, it serves as an essential utility for building stable, secure, and high-performance proxy configurations.

repos.description: Connector for decentralised post-quantum secure network - VeilNet
repos.summary_zh: VeilNet Conflux 是连接去中心化抗量子安全网络的节点软件，采用改进 WebRTC 栈实现点对点通信。核心特性包括基于污点（taint）的访问控制机制，节点需共享污点才能互联；支持 Terra 免费无区域 Realm 和 Conduit 互联网共享模式。通过优化 Exp3 路由算法和自动连接配对，提供低延迟、高吞吐的安全网络连接，适用于构建抗量子威胁的分布式通信基础设施。
repos.summary_en: VeilNet Conflux is a node connector for decentralized post-quantum secure networks, utilizing a modified WebRTC stack for P2P communication. Key features include taint-based access control requiring shared taints for node connectivity, free regionless Terra Realm, and Conduit mode for internet sharing. Optimized with the Exp3 routing algorithm and automatic connection pairing, it delivers low-latency, high-throughput secure networking, ideal for building quantum-resistant distributed communication infrastructure.

repos.description: Automated account registration toolkit for x.ai (Grok) with SSO extraction, OAuth Device Flow, and auto-replenish daemon
repos.summary_zh: 针对x.ai Grok的自动化账号注册工具包，支持curl_cffi引擎注册、YesCaptcha解决Turnstile、SSO令牌提取与OAuth Device Flow铸造、自动补充与令牌刷新守护进程，便于对接API网关账号池。
repos.summary_en: Automated x.ai (Grok) account registration toolkit with curl_cffi engine, YesCaptcha Turnstile solving, SSO-to-CPA token minting via OAuth Device Flow, auto-replenish and token-refresh daemons for API gateway account pools.

repos.summary_zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers的全球加速网络，提供安全便捷的两步验证密钥管理服务。支持TOTP/HOTP自动生成、二维码扫描/图片识别添加、AES-256加密存储，兼容Google Authenticator等多平台导入导出，具备PWA离线使用与WebDAV/S3远程备份能力，适用于个人与企业多设备场景。
repos.summary_en: A secure two-factor authentication (2FA) key management service leveraging Cloudflare Workers for global acceleration. Features include automatic TOTP/HOTP generation, QR code scanning/image recognition for key addition, AES-256 encryption, and seamless import/export from platforms like Google Authenticator. With PWA offline support and remote backup via WebDAV/S3/OneDrive/Google Drive, it provides a unified solution across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

repos.description: Automated QwenCloud account registration & API key harvester with multi-threading, TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth
repos.summary_zh: QwenCloud Generator是一款自动化QwenCloud账户注册与API密钥采集工具，支持多线程Playwright浏览器并发操作、TUI实时仪表盘监控、代理轮换及Gmail OAuth邮箱验证。适用于AI开发者批量获取Qwen大模型API访问权限的场景，具备无头模式、自动恢复和页面状态智能检测等亮点，大幅提升注册效率与匿名性。
repos.summary_en: QwenCloud Generator automates QwenCloud account registration and API key harvesting using multi-threaded Playwright browsers, a TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth for verification. Ideal for AI developers needing bulk API access to Qwen models, it supports headless mode via Xvfb, auto-resume, and scenario detection to handle signup flows efficiently and scalably.

repos.description: OneDrive public directory listing, and One-Click Deploy to Vercel. Powered by Vercel and Next.js.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Next.js 和 Vercel 的 OneDrive 目录列表程序，支持一键部署。通过将配置迁移至 Vercel 环境变量，省去手动修改配置文件的繁琐步骤，实现快速上线。提供文件预览、下载功能，支持文件夹密码保护，并优化 OAuth 认证流程以增强安全性，适合免费搭建私有文件分享站点。
repos.summary_en: A OneDrive directory listing solution built with Next.js and Vercel, featuring one-click deployment. By migrating configurations to Vercel environment variables, it eliminates manual config file editing, enabling rapid setup. Offers file preview and download capabilities, supports password-protected folders, and enhances OAuth security by auto-closing authentication channels.
